senses.gloss:
mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Unfruitful, barren.
2 Vain, unproductive.
f. (-ला)
1 The aloe plant, (Aloes perfoliata.)
2 Another plant, (Flacoartia cataphracta.)
E.
अ neg. फल fruit.

f. (-ता)
Barrenness, unprofitableness.
E.
अफल with तल् affix; also अफलत्वं.

mfn. (-ङ्क्षी-ङ्क्षिणी-ङ्क्षि)
Disinterested, indifferent, not looking to beneficial consequences.
E.
अ neg. फल fruit, and आकाङ्क्षिन् who desires.

mfn. (-ल्गुः-ल्गुः-ल्गु)
Productive, profitable.
E.
अ neg. फल्गु worthless.
